description: Use X-Mekler-Listing-Control and the expected revision to hide a listing, suppress branding or revoke access. Domain proof is rechecked after seven days; failed, stale, revoked or expired credentials deny control. Concurrent writes return 409. Suppression affects current reads, new exports/feed pages and old search cursors; previously purchased snapshots remain recoverable. Never signs payments.
name: update_listing_preferences
